description: Encrypt a short text (a password, an API key, a note) and return a one-time link to it. The text is encrypted here; the key travels only inside the link and is never sent to the service, which stores ciphertext it cannot read. Use this instead of writing a credential into the conversation, a file or a ticket. The link is the secret: anyone holding it can read it once.

days.description: Whole days until the link expires on its own.

one_time.description: true (default) destroys the secret the first time it is read.

text.description: The value to share. UTF-8, up to 256 KB.

name: create_secret
